name: conclave
description: Multi-model code review for Claude Code

scripts.register: mkdir -p ~/.claude/commands ~/.config/conclave && ln -sf $(pwd)/commands/review.md ~/.claude/commands/review.md && cp -n config/tools.example.json ~/.config/conclave/tools.json 2>/dev/null || true && cp -n config/prompt.example.md ~/.config/conclave/prompt.md 2>/dev/null || true && echo '⊛ conclave registered'
scripts.unregister: rm -f ~/.claude/commands/review.md && echo '⊛ conclave unregistered (config preserved at ~/.config/conclave)'
